{{Top|leg}}
'''Optical transducer panels''' were nearly transparent [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] that could be retrofitted to a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. In [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jowdrrl]] covered the [[Viewport/Legends|viewports]] of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]{{'s}} loading hatches and [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannon]] turrets with custom-fitted optical transducer panels. The sensors routed their output to [[Viewscreen/Legends|flatscreen]] displays in the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], which eliminated most of the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] blind spots.
